voiceover: Your keys are gone again — not because you're careless, but because your brain only stores things it saw you put down. That's a working memory gap, not a character flaw. The fix is called a launch pad: one single spot by the door — a tray, a hook, a square of tape on the floor — where everything you need tomorrow lives tonight. Not a drawer. Not 'somewhere logical.' One unmissable spot you walk past anyway. You're not building a habit, you're building a trap your brain can't avoid. Follow for daily ADHD content.
